original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: For the unsigned dirty connector of PR4231 over a ring of characteristic four (k immutable sources, all 2^k-1 nonzero binary-mask outputs, calls B_j: z += B_j x_j and A_m: y_m += A_m z), bound N(4), the largest k at which the floor 4(k+2^k-1) is attained. Lowers PR4248's upper bound 21 to 20 by a parity counting argument valid for every even characteristic, and shows that PR4248's nine-source walk has no ten-source extension.
scope_change_reason: Keeps the PR4231 alphabet and studies the source count, which the card lists as a scope-change trigger. PR4248 left N(4) open between 9 and 21; the floor is the premise any larger-batch consumer of that alphabet would rely on.
bottleneck_link: Side result: bounds the batch size at which a characteristic-four connector consumer can pay exactly four calls per operator. No physical consumer, admission or transfer is supplied, so no kappa change follows.
stop_rule: Stop after the parity counting bound, its instance check and the exhaustive extension check of the certified nine-source walk. Do not start an unbounded search for other nine-source walks.
evidence: verify.py re-checks all 511 masks of the PR4248 nine-source walk, checks the parity collapse lemma on all 59,535 inner boundary subsets of size at most four of that walk and all 91,390 boundary 4-multisets, tabulates both counting thresholds for c <= 12 and k <= 200, and checks all C(40,4) = 91,390 insertions of a tenth source, each with an explicit uncovered mask. Three mutation controls must be rejected.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: What is N(4) exactly, now known to satisfy 9 <= N(4) <= 20?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the largest batch on which the characteristic-four connector pays exactly four calls per operator.
open_questions.first_step: A ten-source floor walk restricts to ten nine-source floor walks, none equal to the PR4248 walk up to relabelling. Generate many inequivalent nine-source floor walks and run the same insertion check on each.
open_questions.blocked_by: Only one nine-source floor walk is known; the space of 36-event walks is too large to enumerate.

open_questions.question: Can the quadratic carry condition give a counting bound far below 20?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Parity uses only the low bit of each coordinate. Writing each stage as u + 2h, a mask also needs sum(h) + e2(u) = 0 over F2 in every coordinate, which heuristically removes a 2^-k fraction of multisets.
open_questions.first_step: Bound the number of 4-subsets of the parity path satisfying the carry condition for one fixed coordinate, then combine coordinates.
open_questions.blocked_by: The k carry conditions are not independent; no rigorous bound is proved.

open_questions.question: Does any concrete consumer use a characteristic-four batch of more than four sources at a favorable complete invoice?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The abstract call counts change no recursive supplier or kappa by themselves.
open_questions.first_step: Identify an immutable-source, unobserved-output caller with coefficients of characteristic four and price every primitive, admission and dispatch.
